div.div: كُدْسٌ مُكَدَّسٌ [What is collected together, of wheat, &c., heaped up much]. (Msb.) You say also عِنْدَهُ مِنْ دَرَاهِمَ وَثِيَابٍ كُدْسٌ مُكَدَّسٌ (tropical:) [He has, of money, and of clothes, a collection heaped up much]: and أَكْدَاسٌ مُكَدَّسَةٌ (tropical:) [collections heaped up]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
